items.front: The Satavahanas are identified with which people in the Puranas?
items.back: The Andhras — the first major power of the Deccan.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Two Satavahana capitals?
items.back: Pratishthana (Paithan) and Amaravati/Dharanikota.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Founder of the Satavahana dynasty?
items.back: Simuka (succeeded by his brother Kanha/Krishna).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which title marked the Satavahanas as Deccan overlords?
items.back: 'Lords of Dakshinapatha'.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which king wrote the Gatha Saptasati, and in what language?
items.back: Hala; in Maharashtri Prakrit.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Greatest Satavahana ruler and the Shaka he defeated?
items.back: Gautamiputra Satakarni; defeated Nahapana (Kshaharata Shaka).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which inscription praises Gautamiputra, and by whom?
items.back: The Nasik Prashasti, by his mother Gautami Balashri.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: What does Satavahana matronymic naming show?
items.back: Names after the mother (Gautami-putra, Vashishthi-putra) — high status of women.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which Shaka ruler's daughter married Vashishthiputra Pulumavi?
items.back: Rudradaman I (known from the Junagadh inscription).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: What were Satavahana coins mainly made of, and a key motif?
items.back: Mostly lead (also copper/potin); ship motif (Roman maritime trade).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Satavahana religious policy?
items.back: Kings performed Vedic sacrifices (Ekabrahmana) yet gave land grants to Buddhist monks.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Who succeeded the Satavahanas in the Andhra region?
items.back: The Ikshvakus (Vijayapuri/Nagarjunakonda); art peaked at Amaravati.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which dynasty became the leading Deccan power after the Mauryas?
items.back: The Satavahanas, from about the 2nd century BCE.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Post Mauryan - Satvahanas.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma and Upinder Singh standard treatment; Satavahana PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-satavahanas.md); AP dossier (.research/ap)

items.front: Which modern states did the Satavahana kingdom cover?

items.front: What political-cultural role did the Satavahanas play?
